title: Kleros decentralized arbitration
description: Off-chain dispute resolution via Kleros, the decentralized juror court. Selects a Kleros subcourt and a minimum juror count for any dispute escalated from this process. This clause names one forum; another forum is another clause. Compose with `figaro-applicable-law` to name the governing law beside it. CHOSEN BY THE BUYER AT CHECKOUT, once for every agreement of the process: the designer composes the clause at assembly scope with no values (no field is a design fill); the buyer chooses the subcourt at checkout, and may set the minimum juror count, 3 when left empty; checkout writes the values into every order's agreement; each seller accepts them by counter-signing its order. Once composed, the subcourt is required and carries no default — the buyer chooses it, and an agreement with the subcourt empty fails the sign gate on both sides. The court set, its value ordering and its position-as-index encoding follow the Kleros developer documentation; the court enum is the declared subset, extended by editing the spec.

fields.name: klerosCourt
fields.label: Subcourt
fields.description: Kleros subcourt, encoded position-as-index: general = 0 (the catch-all); blockchain-nontechnical = 1 / blockchain-technical = 2 (on-chain-agreement disputes); english-language = 3 (disputes hinging on English-language interpretation). To pre-agree no specific forum, omit this whole clause — there is no placeholder court to select.

fields.name: klerosMinJurors
fields.label: Minimum jurors
fields.description: Minimum jurors for the Kleros subcourt, set by the buyer at checkout; 3 when left empty.
